newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares slip as investors lie low.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares slip as investors lie low.

text.p: Slovenian shares continued on their downward trek on Monday, slipping 0.74 percent on low turnover as investors continued to take a wait-and-see stance.

"We are living in a time of uncertainty. There are no foreign investors except for a few speculators -- everyone is waiting for March 10, when banks are expected to set up custody accounts," said Peter Pirc, a trader at Nova Ljubljanska Banka.
Two weeks ago the central bank said that foreign investors would have to open special custody accounts in order to trade in Slovenian securities.
* The SBI index fell 10.23 points to 1,374.80.
* Overall 10 shares fell, three rose and one was unchanged, while 12 were untraded.
* Drug maker Lek was the most active share, firming 0.43 percent to 28,200 tolars on volume of 1,971 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
